title: SAT Newton Basin Boundary Box-Counting Certificate
scope: finite-resolution numerical geometry of a 2D initial-condition slice

result.statement: The measured 2D basin boundary is numerically consistent with a noninteger box-counting dimension over the tested finite-resolution scaling window; the conclusion persists under 4-neighbor/8-neighbor boundary definitions and fit-window variation.
result.boundary: Finite-resolution E1 numerical result for one explicit 3-SAT polynomial system and one 2-D initial-condition slice; not a proof of a universal fractal dimension or a polynomial-time SAT algorithm.
